title: unsigned multiply width tripwire — leftW+rightW matches numeric_std
sourceUrl: internal: handoff §6 item 5 — Bench `*` width trade-off review
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: 5x5-bit `unsigned * unsigned` produces a 10-bit numeric_std product. Tripwire that locks the Phase E widening fix (`Interpreter/Services/Operator.cs`): if the multiply ever truncates to `max(leftW, rightW)` again, 12*11=132 silently loses its MSB on the 9-bit slice (`010000100` becomes `00000100` = 4).
